# P5 Home Co

> P5 Home Co is the parent company behind Boise Construction Co, Boise
> Remodeling Co, Boise Cabinet Co and Boise Handyman Co in the Treasure Valley.
> Boise ADU Co projects currently run through Boise Construction Co; its site
> is coming. P5 is not a directory or referral network.

## What P5 Home Co is

P5 Home Co brings every chapter of homeownership under one family of
specialized companies. Each company has its own specialty, team, and
expertise. What connects them is a shared operating standard: clear
written scopes, one accountable team per project, proactive
communication about decisions and budget impacts, and a clear next step
with the specialist for your project.

Bonded and insured. Serving Ada and Canyon counties.

## Five specialist teams

- [Boise Construction Co](https://boiseconstruction.co): New home
  building. Custom homes, semi-custom homes, building on your own lot,
  and home design and plans. Design, engineering, permitting, and
  construction stay with one accountable team.
- [Boise Remodeling Co](https://boiseremodeling.co): Design-build
  remodeling. Kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, whole-home
  remodeling, additions, and ADUs, managed under one roof with a written
  scope and coordinated permits.
- [Boise ADU Co](https://boiseconstruction.co): Accessory dwelling units.
  Boise ADU Co projects currently run through Boise Construction Co; its site
  is coming.
- [Boise Handyman Co](https://boisehandyman.co): Home repair and
  maintenance. Drywall and trim repair, TV and fixture mounting, deck and
  exterior repair, and general home maintenance.
- [Boise Cabinet Co](https://boisecabinet.co): Custom cabinetry. Premium
  frameless kitchen cabinetry, bathroom vanities, built-ins and storage,
  and whole-home cabinetry, designed, sourced, and installed.

## Which company handles which project

- Building a new home, or building on land you already own: Boise
  Construction Co.
- Renovating, adding on to, or changing how an existing home works:
  Boise Remodeling Co.
- Adding a guest suite, rental unit, or multigenerational living space on
  land you already own: Boise ADU Co.
- Repairs, installations, finish work, and smaller home projects: Boise
  Handyman Co.
- Cabinetry, vanities, built-ins, and coordinated storage: Boise Cabinet
  Co.

Choose the specialist for the job: remodeling with Boise Remodeling Co,
cabinetry with Boise Cabinet Co, new homes with Boise Construction Co,
repairs and RE-10 work with Boise Handyman Co, and ADUs with Boise ADU Co
through the existing P5 intake.

## Service area

Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Kuna, Star, Middleton, Caldwell, and Garden
City, across Ada and Canyon counties in Idaho's Treasure Valley.

## Starting a project

Request a quote at https://p5homeco.com/quote. A name, phone, email, and a
short note are enough. Optional photos or plans help. We reply within one
business day with questions or a time to visit. You get a written scope before
any price.

P5 keeps the request in place with the appropriate discipline recorded:
new homes and additions with Construction, kitchen or broader renovation work
with Remodeling, cabinet-only work with Cabinet, and repairs with Handyman.
Boise ADU Co projects currently run through Boise Construction Co; its site is coming.

The request needs a name and a valid email address or phone number, with a
preferred contact method. A saved receipt confirms the recorded request;
notification and CRM delivery have separate status. Urgent work should go to
(208) 477-1169 rather than the form.

## Contact
